name: mainline_source_neighbor_propagation_v1
statistical_unit: 24 overlapping source archive/fold/family groups, four frozen backends, two prefixes. No new independent-task or deployment inference.
decomposition: Same pair: F13=P10+(P13-P10)+(A10-P10)+[(A13-P13)-(A10-P10)]+(F13-A13). P is a source prior gap only while both endpoints are unobserved; other P gaps are point-update references.
pair_population: Reuse all282 sealed pairs; follow the original30 initial-UU pairs through both prefixes. Current final-UU6 is a separate subset, not a replacement.
decision: No offset, scale or temperature sweep. If saved positive and negative evidence does not identify a consistent unsampled mean-gap mechanism, stop this correction direction; preserve the deployed model.

decision_result.local_mechanism: All three initial-UU newly wrong orders are movements toward the scoring label that overshoot and worsen absolute gap error; two label signs are stable and one is unstable.
decision_result.correction_direction: common objective offset or global scaling of initialization propagation
decision_result.reason: The local overshoots do not identify a prospective correction condition that also preserves the positive source cases; do not infer anchor, covariance or source-family causation.
decision_result.retain: Current AFTER model, initialization propagation, search, terminal, all controls and historical costs.
